edited_files.summary: Purely additive graft on fresh remote: imports calculateFoundationReinforcementItemProjection; adds REINFORCEMENT_SNAPSHOT_FIELDS + calculateVersionedItem; dispatch at top of calcItem (unmarked/version-1 → null → unchanged legacy path); per-item versioned pass in calcProject feeding blockers into the shared input-issue channel; include_rebar masked to false for version-2 items inside the delivery volume scan (local semantics).

Additive version gate inside foundationItemInputIssues: unsupported version (non-null, non-1, non-2) reports foundation_reinforcement_version_unsupported and returns; version 2 checks include_rebar boolean-ness then maps version-2 model errors (geometryLimit:0) onto reinforcement_design.* fields and skips legacy rebar field checks; version absent/1 falls through to untouched legacy checks.

Additive v2 branch in foundationItemCatalogIssues: versioned items with a catalog reinforcement_material require exactly one current inventory row by id with material_type 'rebar' (catalog_item_unassigned/ambiguous/unavailable); early return so the legacy rebar_size fallback cannot substitute for a missing selected id. Legacy path untouched.
